description.desc: Applies damage over time to enemies nearby. Affliction's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.
description.quip: Apply damage over time to enemies nearby
description.t3_desc: Prevents all healing +13.0 DPS with increase Spirit scaling

description.desc: Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time . Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.
description.quip: Shoot enemies to set them on fire

description.desc: Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.
description.t3_desc: -7s Cooldown and +2m Radius Applies -30% Fire Rate

description.desc: Curse an enemy hero. If they don't move away from their initial position within the escape time , they will be damaged and immobilized .
description.quip: Curse your target, rooting them if they don't escape
description.t1_desc: Warden deals +20% more Bullet Damage to trapped Heroes for 5s
description.t3_desc: -14s Cooldown Silences enemies until they escape or are immobilized

description.desc: Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time. Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.
description.quip: Sacrifice some health to launch a damaging bomb
description.t3_desc: Bombs leave a toxic mess on the ground, dealing 26.0% of the original damage per second , for 6s .

description.desc: Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
description.quip: Heals from targets ahead of you

description.passive: While you are below 50% health , you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.

section_attributes.loc_string: While you are below 50% health , you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.

description.desc: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

section_attributes.loc_string: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

description.desc: Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.
description.quip: Slam down to the ground, damaging enemies
description.t2_desc: Struck enemies are knocked up and slowed by 50% for 3s
description.t3_desc: Damage Per Meter +110% and improved scaling

description.desc: Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you . Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced. to give health to friendly Heroes .
description.quip: Steal health from an enemy over time
description.t3_desc: Enables and Grants +2 Charges. Increases spirit scaling.

description.desc: Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius . Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.
description.quip: Launch a damaging ball of lightning
description.t2_desc: -35% move speed on hit targets and +1s Lifetime

description.desc: Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.

section_attributes.loc_string: Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.
This effect can only trigger once per target per ultimate.

description.desc: Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.
description.quip: Stack damage amplification on an enemy

description.desc: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health .

section_attributes.loc_string: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health .

description.desc: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , bonus fire rate , and reloads bullets on use.

section_attributes.loc_string: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , bonus fire rate , and reloads bullets on use.

description.active: Grants Lifesteal , Fire Rate , and Ammo . This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

section_attributes.loc_string: Grants Lifesteal , Fire Rate , and Ammo . This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

description.desc: After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done. While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
description.quip: Emit pulses that steal health from enemies

description.desc: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

section_attributes.loc_string: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

description.desc: Gain a Barrier and bonus move speed.
description.quip: Gain a Barrier and move speed
description.t3_desc: +40% Debuff Resistance and improved Barrier scaling
